name: Crystal Palace
description: The premier dining destination at Lotte World — Crystal Palace is an elegant buffet restaurant serving a wide selection of Korean and international dishes including Korean BBQ, sushi, pasta, roasted meats and traditional Korean favourites in a grand and beautifully decorated setting inside Magic Island.

items.name: Korean BBQ Set
items.description: Marinated beef bulgogi and pork belly grilled at the table with banchan sides

items.name: Seafood Platter
items.description: Fresh seafood selection with sauces and seasonal accompaniments

items.name: Lunch Buffet
items.description: All-you-can-eat Korean and international buffet — lunch service

items.name: Dinner Buffet
items.description: Premium evening all-you-can-eat buffet with extended selection

name: Aqua Garden Cafe
description: A bright and charming cafe with beautiful views over the Lotte World outdoor lake — serving Korean snacks, light meals, coffee and desserts in a relaxed atmosphere. One of the most pleasant and scenic dining spots in the entire Lotte World complex.

items.name: Tteokbokki
items.description: Spicy rice cake in gochujang sauce with fish cake and spring onion

items.name: Hotteok
items.description: Sweet Korean pancake filled with cinnamon sugar and walnuts

items.name: Bingsu
items.description: Shaved ice dessert with sweet red bean and condensed milk

name: Snack Victoria
description: A popular quick-service food outlet in the Magic Island area serving Korean street food classics including corn dogs, chicken skewers and Korean-style snacks — ideal for a fast and satisfying bite between rides.

items.name: Korean Corn Dog
items.description: Crispy battered corn dog with choice of cheese or potato coating

items.name: Chicken Skewer
items.description: Grilled seasoned chicken skewer with sweet and spicy sauce

items.name: Kimbap Roll
items.description: Korean rice roll with egg, vegetables and seasoned rice

name: World Tower Restaurant
description: A prestigious restaurant in the Lotte World Tower offering panoramic views over Seoul and serving premium Korean cuisine including traditional Korean set menus, hansik tasting menus and seasonal Korean specialities prepared by master chefs.

items.name: Hansik Tasting Menu
items.description: Multi-course traditional Korean dining experience with seasonal ingredients

items.description: Premium stone pot bibimbap with choice of beef or vegetable topping

items.description: Braised short ribs in soy and Asian pear marinade with seasonal vegetables

items.description: Traditional Korean rice wine served chilled
